game.name: Example: High Card
game.description: A simple 2-player card game. Each turn a player plays a card from their hand; highest card wins the round. First to 5 round wins takes the game.

components.name: Standard deck
components.description: 52-card standard deck, suits ignored. Cards ranked 2–14 (Ace high).

setup.description: Deal 5 cards to each player face-down. Players may look at their own hand.
Randomly determine which player goes first.

turn_structure.name: Play card
turn_structure.description: The active player selects one card from their hand and plays it face-up to the table.

turn_structure.name: Reveal & resolve
turn_structure.description: Both players reveal their played card. The player with the higher card wins 1 point. Ties award no points.

actions.description: Play one card from your hand face-up.
conditions: The player must have at least one card in hand.
effects: The chosen card is removed from the player's hand.
The card value is compared to the opponent's played card.
The player with the higher value gains 1 point. Ties score nothing.

win_conditions.description: First player to reach 5 round wins takes the game.
If all cards are exhausted with no winner, the player with more points wins. Tiebreaker: neither player wins (draw).

edge_cases.situation: Both players play a card of equal value on the same turn.
edge_cases.ruling: Neither player scores a point. Both cards are discarded. Play continues.
edge_cases.notes: This is the only way a turn ends with no score change.

edge_cases.situation: A player has no cards left in hand but the game has not ended.
edge_cases.ruling: The game ends immediately. The player with the higher score wins.
edge_cases.notes: Should not occur in normal play with the turn limit, but included as a safety ruling.
